# 1. Partial Derivatives and Gradients

::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills}

## Intro

#### A Function with Many Inputs

Our black box could accept many inputs. If we have two inputs, then to draw a graph I need to axes for variables, and a third axis for the output. If we want graphs of functions of three or more variables, we are out of luck.

#### Partial Derivatives and Tangent Planes

Sensitivity to each input. If we have 2 inputs, graph is a surface and so it no longer has just a tangent line, it has a tangent plane. This plane is linear with the same "sensitivity" to x and y as original f.

#### The Gradient

A vector of partial derivatives. Why does it give direction of steepest increase?
